description: Twenty-five native Property routes completing remaining P3/P4/P5 allocations. Native mutation acknowledgement is not persistence qualification.

contracts.name: GetOrthotropic3DMaterialCount
contracts.summary: Reads the count of orthotropic 3D material definitions.
contracts.returns: Success with the actual nonnegative count, including zero; the integral response is retained as evidence.
contracts.remarks: When to use: size or inspect the orthotropic 3D inventory. A count is not an upper bound on native material number IDs and does not establish their indexing. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: GetOrthotropic3DMaterialProperties
contracts.summary: Reads all eighteen constants of one native orthotropic 3D material.
parameters: nativeMaterialNumber
Nonnegative native material number ID established by the caller. It is not inferred from the 3D count or a managed zero/one-based list index.
contracts.returns: Success with the exact native name and eighteen owned immutable constants; native null/DBNull/empty name yields NotFound with no Data.
contracts.remarks: When to use: obtain anisotropic constants without an isotropic E/Poisson-to-G relation. Sends six sentinel double arrays of exactly three slots each, including density, alpha and damping. Every returned array must be rank one, exactly length three, floating-point and finite. Native first/second/third order is retained without guessing physical axis/plane labels. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: RemoveMaterialFromBeam
contracts.summary: Removes a material assignment from one analytical member.
parameters: memberId
Positive analytical member ID in the acquired model; not a section property ID, table number or section type.
contracts.returns: Succeeded for integral zero, NativeFailure for -1; retains the requested member ID and actual return code.
contracts.remarks: When to use: deliberately clear a member material assignment while retaining the material definition. Does not delete a definition or replace the assignment with a default material. Native success is an acknowledgement only, not persistence read-back or engineering certification. Changes may remain after a native failure, stale-binding exception or transport error. No analysis, implicit save, retry, transaction or rollback occurs.

contracts.name: GetSolidMaterialName
contracts.summary: Reads the exact material name assigned to an analytical solid.
parameters: solidId
Positive analytical solid ID in the acquired model; not a plate/member ID or material number.
contracts.returns: Success with the exact native string. Null/DBNull/empty names yield EmptyOrUnavailable because no-assignment and missing-entity states cannot be distinguished.
contracts.remarks: When to use: inspect solid material assignment without hydrating solid geometry. Retains whitespace and does not reinterpret the material name as its classification. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: GetIsotropicMaterialAssignedSolidCount
contracts.summary: Reads the count of solids assigned to a named isotropic material.
parameters: materialName
Exact nonblank native material name without NUL characters. Case and whitespace are preserved; no material is created by this input.
contracts.returns: Success with the nonnegative native count; zero does not prove the named material exists. Negative/Boolean/fractional counts are malformed.
contracts.remarks: When to use: inspect assignment size before requesting IDs. The help documents a count, without a separate missing-material code. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: GetIsotropicMaterialAssignedSolidIds
contracts.summary: Reads a bounded owned snapshot of solid IDs assigned to an isotropic material.
parameters: materialName
Exact nonblank native material name without NUL characters. Case and whitespace are preserved; no material is created by this input.
maximumResults
Allocation limit from 1 through 100000, default 100000. A larger native count returns LimitExceeded before allocating/retrieving a list.
contracts.returns: Success with a read-only owned ID list retaining native order and duplicates; zero count gives an empty list without retrieval. False retrieval gives NativeFailure; changed before/after counts give StateChanged.
contracts.remarks: When to use: enumerate assignment IDs without loading solids. Uses GetIsotropicMaterialAssignedSolidCount before and after GetIsotropicMaterialAssignedSolidList; checks rank-one Int32 shape, exact length and positive written IDs. Every native dispatch rechecks captured receiver binding. Count equality cannot rule out same-count external edits; no model-wide atomic snapshot is promised. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: SetTypeToIsotropicMaterial
contracts.summary: Sets the classification of an existing named isotropic material.
parameters: materialName
Exact nonblank native material name without NUL characters. Case and whitespace are preserved; no material is created by this input.
materialType
Defined classification: NotSpecified=0, Steel=1, Concrete=2, Aluminum=3 or Timber=4. Unknown enum values are rejected before native access.
contracts.returns: Succeeded for true/integral one, NativeFailure for false/integral zero, with exact name and actual return representation.
contracts.remarks: When to use: change material classification without creating a material or supplying elastic/design constants. Acknowledgement does not mean that E, G, density or strengths were changed. Native success is an acknowledgement only, not persistence read-back or engineering certification. Changes may remain after a native failure, stale-binding exception or transport error. No analysis, implicit save, retry, transaction or rollback occurs.

contracts.name: GetTypeForIsotropicMaterial
contracts.summary: Reads the native classification of an isotropic material.
parameters: materialName
Exact nonblank native material name without NUL characters. Case and whitespace are preserved; no material is created by this input.
contracts.returns: Success with a defined classification 0 through 4; false/zero gives NotFound. An unwritten or unknown type on success throws.
contracts.remarks: When to use: inspect classification independently from material constants. Native NotSpecified=0 is successful data, distinct from a false return indicating no such material. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: GetSectionPropertiesForProfile
contracts.summary: Reads the ten native section values for an ASSIGN profile selector.
parameters: profileType
Defined ASSIGN profile selector: Angle=0, DoubleAngle=1, Beam=2, Column=3 or Channel=4. Not a property reference ID.
contracts.returns: Success for native zero with width/depth, Ax/Ay/Az, native Ix/Iy/Iz and flange/web thickness. -3001 gives NotFound and -6022 NotAssigned; failures have no Data.
contracts.remarks: When to use: query GetSectionPropertyValues using its documented profile selector, rather than a member or property ID. The older GetSectionPropertyValues(int propId) compatibility method calls the different native GetSectionPropertyValuesEx property-ID route and remains unchanged. All ten scalar outputs must be explicitly written finite floating-point values. Length, area and inertia slots retain native units and names; no physical-axis reinterpretation is inferred. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: GetBeamSectionPropertyRefNo
contracts.summary: Reads the section property reference assigned to a member.
parameters: memberId
Positive analytical member ID in the acquired model; not a section property ID, table number or section type.
contracts.returns: Success with a positive native property reference. Native zero gives EmptyOrUnavailable, without distinguishing missing member from missing assignment.
contracts.remarks: When to use: bridge a member identity to existing property-ID readers. Negative results are undocumented and throw. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: GetBeamSectionPropertyValuesEx
contracts.summary: Reads the version-decoded section-value packet directly from a member.
parameters: memberId
Positive analytical member ID in the acquired model; not a section property ID, table number or section type.
contracts.returns: Success with an immutable member identity, native type/version, applicable field labels and matching read-only values. False/zero gives NativeFailure with no Data.
contracts.remarks: When to use: inspect assigned member section parameters without synthesizing a property reference, country, catalog identity or area. Allocates the documented fixed 24-double sentinel buffer, validates its exact rank/type/length, and validates only applicable slots using the reviewed native STAAD 24/25/26 layout selected at execution from wrapper.StaadVersion. Unknown versions/types fail explicitly. Unused padding is excluded. Required nonfinite/unwritten values throw. No extra entity lookup or atomic external-edit guarantee is implied. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: GetSectionTableNo
contracts.summary: Reads the native section table number for a member.
parameters: memberId
Positive analytical member ID in the acquired model; not a section property ID, table number or section type.
contracts.returns: Success with a nonnegative native table number (including zero); -3001 is NotFound, -6004 InvalidReference (profile database section absent), and -6022 NotAssigned.
contracts.remarks: When to use: inspect table identity for an assigned member. This output is not a country code, property reference ID or section type code. Unknown nonnegative codes are retained. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: GetBeamSectionPropertyTypeNo
contracts.summary: Reads the native section property type code for a member.
parameters: memberId
Positive analytical member ID in the acquired model; not a section property ID, table number or section type.
contracts.returns: Success with a positive raw native type code, including unknown positive codes. Zero gives NativeFailure; undocumented negatives throw.
contracts.remarks: When to use: inspect section type without decoding its value layout. A retained unknown type does not imply layout support in GetBeamSectionPropertyValuesEx. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: GetBeamSectionName
contracts.summary: Reads the exact section name assigned to a member.
parameters: memberId
Positive analytical member ID in the acquired model; not a section property ID, table number or section type.
contracts.returns: Success with the exact nonempty native string; null/DBNull/empty yields EmptyOrUnavailable, without guessing whether the member or assignment is missing.
contracts.remarks: When to use: obtain the native base name, which can be shared by differently modified assignments. Does not construct a catalog designation or parse dimensions from the string. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: GetBeamSectionDisplayName
contracts.summary: Reads the exact display section name assigned to a member.
parameters: memberId
Positive analytical member ID in the acquired model; not a section property ID, table number or section type.
contracts.returns: Success with the exact nonempty native string; null/DBNull/empty yields EmptyOrUnavailable, without guessing whether the member or assignment is missing.
contracts.remarks: When to use: show the native assignment description, which may include modifiers and spacing. Does not construct a catalog designation or parse dimensions from the string. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: GetCountryTableNo
contracts.summary: Reads the native country code associated with a member section.
parameters: memberId
Positive analytical member ID in the acquired model; not a section property ID, table number or section type.
contracts.returns: Success with a nonnegative raw country code, retaining zero and unknown positive codes. -3001 gives NotFound; -6022 gives NotAssigned.
contracts.remarks: When to use: inspect the country of an assigned member section. The input is a member ID; the output is a country code, not a section table number. No forced conversion to the repository Country enum occurs. Inspect IsSuccessful and Status before reading Data. Known absence/failure states do not expose default data; malformed values, undocumented status codes and transport failures throw. No conversion, hydration, model write, save or catalog lookup occurs.

contracts.name: CreateAssignProfileProperty
contracts.summary: Creates an ASSIGN profile section definition.
parameters: profileType
Defined ASSIGN profile selector: Angle=0, DoubleAngle=1, Beam=2, Column=3 or Channel=4. Not a property reference ID.
contracts.returns: Created with a separate positive CreatedPropertyId on success; zero is NativeFailure and -6008 InvalidInput. The actual native code and requested profile are retained.
contracts.remarks: When to use: create one of the five ASSIGN profile definitions. Does not assign members or fabricate section dimensions. Native success is an acknowledgement only, not persistence read-back or engineering certification. Changes may remain after a native failure, stale-binding exception or transport error. No analysis, implicit save, retry, transaction or rollback occurs.

contracts.name: AssignElementSpecToPlate
contracts.summary: Assigns an existing element specification to explicit plate IDs.
parameters: plateIds
Finite sequence of 1 through 100000 positive analytical plate IDs. Enumerated once with a hard bound; order/duplicates retained. Empty/null/invalid sequences are rejected before native writes.
specificationId
Positive existing native element specification ID; no specification is created or inferred.
contracts.returns: Succeeded for integral zero, InvalidInput for -106 (native array representation rejected), NativeFailure for -6017. Retains requested IDs/specification and actual code.
contracts.remarks: When to use: deliberately apply an already-created element specification. Sends an owned Int32 array even for one plate; native help requires the array route. There is no per-plate success result, so partial native assignment is possible. Native success is an acknowledgement only, not persistence read-back or engineering certification. Changes may remain after a native failure, stale-binding exception or transport error. No analysis, implicit save, retry, transaction or rollback occurs.

contracts.name: UpdatePropertiesToDesignSection
contracts.summary: Updates model section assignments to their design sections.
contracts.returns: Succeeded for true/integral one and NativeFailure for false/integral zero, retaining the actual representation and model-wide scope.
contracts.remarks: When to use: deliberately apply existing design section selections to the acquired model. This is a whole-model mutation; does not run design/analysis or produce a per-member change report. Native success is an acknowledgement only, not persistence read-back or engineering certification. Changes may remain after a native failure, stale-binding exception or transport error. No analysis, implicit save, retry, transaction or rollback occurs.

contracts.name: CreateIsotropicMaterialPropertiesEx
contracts.summary: Creates or updates an isotropic material with explicit extended strengths.
parameters: material

Non-null immutable definition with explicit name, E, Poisson, G, weight density, thermal expansion and damping in the acquired native creation convention. No defaults, derived G or conversion are applied.
strengths
Non-null immutable explicit Fy, Fu, Ry, Rt and Fcu packet. All strengths/ratios are finite nonnegative and sent in this native order without conversion.
contracts.returns: Created for integral zero, Updated for one, NativeFailure for -1. Retains exact material name and actual code; no material ID is inferred.
contracts.remarks: When to use: explicitly request all five extended strength fields through the native route. Native acknowledgement does not prove strength persistence; the older obsolete compatibility creator was excluded because persistence was not verified. This method exposes only the native acknowledgement, without a read-back guarantee. Native success is an acknowledgement only, not persistence read-back or engineering certification. Changes may remain after a native failure, stale-binding exception or transport error. No analysis, implicit save, retry, transaction or rollback occurs.

contracts.signature: PropertyMutationResult CreateIsotropicMaterialSteel(IsotropicMaterialDefinition material, SteelMaterialStrengths strengths, bool isPhysical)
contracts.name: CreateIsotropicMaterialSteel
contracts.summary: Creates or updates a Steel material with explicit strengths and physical flag.
parameters: material

Non-null immutable definition with explicit name, E, Poisson, G, weight density, thermal expansion and damping in the acquired native creation convention. No defaults, derived G or conversion are applied.
strengths
Non-null immutable explicit Fu, Fy, Rt and Ry packet. Sent in this native order, which differs from CreateIsotropicMaterialPropertiesEx.
isPhysical
Explicit native physical-material flag; forwarded unchanged. Does not create physical members or assign entities.
contracts.returns: Created for integral zero, Updated for one, NativeFailure for -1, with exact name and actual code; statuses are not material IDs.
contracts.remarks: When to use: explicitly request Steel creation/classification and strength fields. Does not derive strengths, convert units or certify that all design fields persisted. Native success is an acknowledgement only, not persistence read-back or engineering certification. Changes may remain after a native failure, stale-binding exception or transport error. No analysis, implicit save, retry, transaction or rollback occurs.

contracts.signature: PropertyMutationResult CreateIsotropicMaterialConcrete(IsotropicMaterialDefinition material, double compressiveStrength, bool isPhysical)
contracts.name: CreateIsotropicMaterialConcrete
contracts.summary: Creates or updates a Concrete material with explicit Fcu and physical flag.
parameters: material

Non-null immutable definition with explicit name, E, Poisson, G, weight density, thermal expansion and damping in the acquired native creation convention. No defaults, derived G or conversion are applied.
compressiveStrength
Finite nonnegative Fcu in the acquired native stress convention. Sent unchanged; no cylinder/cube conversion is inferred.
isPhysical
Explicit native physical-material flag; forwarded unchanged. Does not create physical members or assign entities.
contracts.returns: Created for integral zero, Updated for one, NativeFailure for -1; exact name and native code retained without a fabricated material ID.
contracts.remarks: When to use: explicitly request Concrete creation and its compressive strength field. No default strength, conversion or strength-persistence guarantee is supplied. Native success is an acknowledgement only, not persistence read-back or engineering certification. Changes may remain after a native failure, stale-binding exception or transport error. No analysis, implicit save, retry, transaction or rollback occurs.

contracts.name: CreateIsotropicMaterialAluminum
contracts.summary: Creates or updates a Aluminum material from explicit common constants.
parameters: material

Non-null immutable definition with explicit name, E, Poisson, G, weight density, thermal expansion and damping in the acquired native creation convention. No defaults, derived G or conversion are applied.
isPhysical
Explicit native physical-material flag; forwarded unchanged. Does not create physical members or assign entities.
contracts.returns: Created for integral zero, Updated for one, NativeFailure for -1. Retains exact material name/native code; no material ID is fabricated.
contracts.remarks: When to use: explicitly request the native Aluminum creator without assuming built-in material defaults or deriving shear modulus. No design strength packet is accepted by this native function. Native success is an acknowledgement only, not persistence read-back or engineering certification. Changes may remain after a native failure, stale-binding exception or transport error. No analysis, implicit save, retry, transaction or rollback occurs.

contracts.name: CreateIsotropicMaterialTimber
contracts.summary: Creates or updates a Timber material from explicit common constants.
parameters: material

Non-null immutable definition with explicit name, E, Poisson, G, weight density, thermal expansion and damping in the acquired native creation convention. No defaults, derived G or conversion are applied.
isPhysical
Explicit native physical-material flag; forwarded unchanged. Does not create physical members or assign entities.
contracts.returns: Created for integral zero, Updated for one, NativeFailure for -1. Retains exact material name/native code; no material ID is fabricated.
contracts.remarks: When to use: explicitly request the native Timber creator without assuming built-in material defaults or deriving shear modulus. No design strength packet is accepted by this native function. Native success is an acknowledgement only, not persistence read-back or engineering certification. Changes may remain after a native failure, stale-binding exception or transport error. No analysis, implicit save, retry, transaction or rollback occurs.

contracts.name: AssignMaterialToSolid
contracts.summary: Assigns an existing named material to explicit analytical solids.
parameters: materialName
Exact nonblank native material name without NUL characters. Case and whitespace are preserved; no material is created by this input.
solidIds
Finite sequence of 1 through 100000 positive analytical solid IDs. Enumerated once with a hard bound and copied; empty/null/invalid input is rejected. Order and duplicates are retained.
contracts.returns: Succeeded for true/integral one, NativeFailure for false/integral zero. Retains exact name, owned read-only requested solid IDs and actual return evidence.
contracts.remarks: When to use: assign solid material directly without entity hydration. Uses the documented native Int32-array route even for a single solid. Does not create the material, change current material context or report per-solid completion; partial assignment can remain. Native success is an acknowledgement only, not persistence read-back or engineering certification. Changes may remain after a native failure, stale-binding exception or transport error. No analysis, implicit save, retry, transaction or rollback occurs.
